title: Lutos, no irrigation, small holding in Dobrogea, mid-September
rationale: A small unirrigated holding on good loam in the Dobrogea steppe. Lutos is suitable for every candidate, so grau_toamna is asserted into the top on soil plus its south/west window (10-01 → 10-10). Both orderings put rapita_toamna last of the three named crops: drought_tolerance scazuta against wheat's medie and rye's ridicata, no irrigation, 2 drought-flagged years in 10, a -8.4 mm last-month precipitation anomaly, and rapița's critical establishment period falling in exactly these weeks. rapița stays a legal pick — its southern window (09-05 → 09-15) is open on the case date and Dobrogea's 552 mm annual normal clears the 450 mm season need — so it is ordered, not excluded.
